template_data.lead_html: Three questions before you commit to any vehicle.

rows.what_html: Do you have GSA Schedule? — OASIS+ and SEWP both require it
What's your past performance? — MAS has the lowest barrier to entry
Who's your target agency? — 15 min on usaspending.gov saves months

template_data.closer: BUILD THE SCHEDULE FIRST. EVERYTHING STACKS ON TOP.
